question: The Harsha inscription of 554 CE mentions the rise of Yajnavarman from which place?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Harsha inscription of 554 CE** mentions the rise of **Yajnavarman**, a ruler who emerged from **Gaya**.
 
• **Gaya** is an ancient city located in the state of **Bihar, India**.
 
• It is historically significant due to its association with **Buddhism**, **Hinduism**, and the presence of the **Maha Bodhi Temple**, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The city of Gaya has been a prominent religious and cultural center, well-known for its **Pind Daan rituals** performed by Hindus for their ancestors.
 
• Yajnavarman’s rise marked a political shift during the post-Gupta period, reflecting the local power dynamics in the region.
 
• The Harsha inscription provides valuable historical insight into the **regional rulers** and their contributions during the period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Thanesar**__

 __
 
• **Thanesar** is a historic town located in the state of **Haryana, India**.
 
• It was the capital of the **Pushyabhuti dynasty**, which Harsha later ruled.
 
• Thanesar was a prominent center of **political and religious activities** during the early medieval period.
 
• It is also associated with the famous ruler **Harsha Vardhana** who expanded his empire from this region.
 
 
 
• **Magadha**__
 __
 
• **Magadha** was an ancient kingdom located in what is now **Bihar, India**.
 
• It was one of the most powerful kingdoms in ancient India, and its prominence rose during the reign of the **Maurya and Gupta dynasties.**
 
• Magadha is famous for its role in the spread of **Buddhism** and **Jainism**.
 
• The region was home to cities like **Pataliputra**, which served as an important political and economic hub.
 
 
 
• **Kannauj**__
 
 
• **Kannauj** was an important city in northern India and served as the capital of several dynasties, including the **Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty**.
 
• It is located in the present-day state of **Uttar Pradesh, India**.
 
• Kannauj was known for its **rich cultural heritage**, especially its role in the production of **perfumes**.
 
• The city played a significant role in medieval Indian history, often contested by various empires for its strategic importance.
